items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: In the band with Basie, we had a good lead trombone player, Dan Minor.

ctx.x: Because I imagine some of them might not be so well known, because they often aren't soloists, or at least not what you might call Jazz soloists.

Yeah... See, that's the thing; I can't remember names. I wish I could. In the band with Basie, we had a good lead trombone player, Dan Minor. He's not heard of much. No one ever heard him, but he was with Basie when I was there. Dickie Wells... And Dickie Wells played a lot of lead, too, and that was beautiful. He was a beautiful lead trombone. Henry Coker... Oh, gee, I can't name them, you know...

And as far as records is concerned, then you have to go into another bag, because I don't remember who I played with on records, and there were so many great trombonists who were straight lead men, you know...
